title: Find lexical entries
description: Lists lexical entries from the current Baseline by form regular expression, form suffix, inflection class, category, morph type, gloss or text, with canonical or guid ids, paging past 100 and a batch mode that opens the Baseline once for many questions. It reads the saved copy and never opens or changes the live FieldWorks project.
usage: Usage: motif lexicon find --project <fwdata> [--query <text> | --exact <form>] [--form-regex <regex>] [--suffix <text>] [--class <name|id>] [--environment <text>] [--stem-name <name|id>] [--used-by <slot|template>] [--detail] [--morph-type <name>[,<name>]] [--affix [true|false]] [--category <name|id>] [--headword <prefix>] [--headword-contains <text>] [--has-gloss [true|false]] [--id-format canonical|guid] [--at baseline|<proposalId>] [--limit <1-200>] [--offset <n> | --page <N> | --all] [--json]
